knowledge_gaps: Attention selectivity is constrained: unit-temperature cosine logits differ by at most 2. The lag-nine recency penalty is approximately 2.008, so the oldest event cannot receive more attention than the newest valid event, regardless of learned similarity. A temperature or explicit justification for this restriction is missing.

The residual lies in [-1,1], so it can change a positive-negative margin by at most 2 for fixed backbone scores. Its practical influence depends on baseline score scales and near-cutoff candidate gaps; the reported training margins do not establish that alpha=1 is appropriate.

Reproduction details remain incomplete: embedding initialization distribution and scale, normalization epsilon, branch regularization, optimizer parameter groups, explicit scoring-mode dispatch, actual remaining GPU budget, common epoch allocation, and interruption/checkpoint rules. Nonzero initialization alone does not specify stable normalized-embedding gradients.

Three catalog-sized embedding tables add approximately 96N parameters per category, plus gradients and optimizer state. Calling this a small branch needs catalog-size and runtime estimates, including full-catalog recommendations for the twenty simulator users.

The candidate-independent control leaves the attention table unused, so it does not fully match effective capacity. Originality 3 is reasonable, but potential 7 and difficulty 5 remain provisional. DARE-style separation is invoked without an identifiable reference or explanation of its correspondence to this architecture.

The prior combined_score=0.5600 lacks confirmed provenance under the pinned macro validation HR@10. The report also omits the earlier conditional paired uncertainty analysis and an explicit limitation on further simulator-driven tuning. Popularity and common-transition shortcuts remain possible despite bounded attention.
